data.one_liner: Type-safe isolated thread with event emitter for async communication
data.what_it_does: Provides a lightweight wrapper around Dart Isolates that uses a type‑safe EventEmitter to send and receive data. It supports starting, pausing, resuming, and stopping the isolate, as well as running single tasks via compute methods.
use_when: Need to offload CPU‑heavy work to a background isolate
Require event‑driven communication between isolate and main thread
Want to pause or resume isolate execution
Need a simple API without external dependencies
avoid_when: When performance of starting/stopping isolates is critical
When you already use a more feature‑rich concurrency library
weaknesses: Recent breaking changes in file structure and imports
Not widely adopted, community support is small
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import 'package:thread/thread.dart'; no special permissions or build_runner needed
